subject: Dedicated single-tenant pricing — compliance premium & GPU pool sizing (MediSys)
messages:
From: Ana Perez <procurement@medisys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medisys.com; jordan@nimbuscloud.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity quote request — single-tenant + KMS/audit

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo today. MediSys is interested in a Reserved Dedicated deployment with single-tenant isolation. A few must-haves for our procurement/security teams:

- Customer-managed KMS integration (bring-your-own-key)
- Audit log retention 7 years, access exportable to our SIEM
- Subprocessor list and SOC 2 reports
- Throughput guarantee: baseline 750 inference requests/s with burst to 1,500 req/s for short spikes (avg request = ~600 tokens)
- GPU sizing recommendation; our infra team prefers minimum isolation equivalent to ~8x A100-80GB or 4x H100 (for model X performance).

Can you provide a written proposal with pricing for: 12-month and 24-month reserved commits, the compliance premium for single-tenant isolation, and any available discounts for marketplace/cloud partner credits (we may onboard via NimbusCloud)? Also need typical lead time for private deployment and required network/IP allowlist.

Thanks — can you get something over to procurement by end of day Friday?

Regards,
Ana Perez
Sr. Procurement Manager
MediSys Health

(Attachment: Medisys_RFP_Summary.xlsx - referenced)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Perez <procurement@medisys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; jordan@nimbuscloud.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity quote request — single-tenant + KMS/audit

Ana — appreciate the detailed list. High-level proposal attached; summary below. I’ll follow up with a short call if needed.

Option A — 12-month reserved commit (recommended starting point):
- GPU pool: 8x A100-80GB equivalent (single-tenant pool)
- Baseline throughput: 750 req/s (SLA: 99.5% monthly), burst up to 1,500 req/s with autoscale buffer
- Token throughput: ~1.2M tokens/min baseline (model/seq dependent)
- Compliance: single-tenant + BYOK KMS + audit logs (retention configurable; default 7 years)
- Pricing: $85k/month list for the pool + $0.0045 per 1k tokens over baseline usage
- Compliance premium: +20% on list for single-tenant + KMS + extended audit retention
- 12-month commit discount: 15% off list (applies before compliance premium)

Option B — 24-month reserved commit (preferred for deep discount):
- Same pool as A
- Pricing: $75k/month list
- Compliance premium: +15% for 24-month (lower premium due to longer commit)
- 24-month commit discount: 25% off list

Additional commercial notes:
- Marketplace/partner credits: if deployed via NimbusCloud, we can apply an additional 5% credit (coordination with Jordan required)
- Performance credits: for missed throughput SLOs we propose a monthly credit ladder (5-30% depending on severity)
- Lead time: 4–6 weeks for private single-tenant setup (network, KMS config, audit pipeline)

I attached a draft proposal (Redwood_Proposal_MediSys_20251105.pdf) and a starter SOW. Happy to walk through numbers on Friday. If you want a hard counter from Procurement, send numbers and we’ll see what we can flex on.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
(Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_MediSys_20251105.pdf; SOW-MediSys-Dedicated-20251105.docx)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Perez <procurement@medisys.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity quote request — single-tenant + KMS/audit

Karthik — quick internal notes (looping Ana for transparency):

1) KMS: confirm flow for BYOK. Need API endpoint list and whether we need HSM-level attestation.
2) Audit logs: 7-year retention ok but need sizing estimate (logs/day) and export format (JSON/CEF). Also need retention toggle for eDiscovery requests.
3) Pricing: compliance premium at 20% is reasonable, but Laura from Procurement will want a floor case (12-month at 12% premium if they can provide SOC 2 + annual penetration test reports).
4) Throughput SLA: define measurement (p50 p95 p99 latencies or requests/s) and exact credit triggers.
5) Attachments: SOW needs a short runbook for failover and fallback model routing.

Can you draft a counter that shows: list price, applied discounts, final monthly invoice, and expected monthly effective rate after credits? I’ll review before we send the formal counter.

Thanks,
Laura
Legal & Contracts (sales support)
Redwood Inference

> On Wed, Nov 5, 2025 at 11:08 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (attached proposal)
From: Michael Chang <security@medisys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Ana Perez <procurement@medisys.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity quote request — single-tenant + KMS/audit

Karthik,

Thanks for the draft. A couple of questions / redlines from our security team:

- Subprocessor list: need full list and contract language confirming notification for new subprocessors 30 days prior.
- Pen testing: require annual pen test results and remediation windows (we prefer 90 days).
- Data isolation proof: can you provide an architecture diagram and poof-of-isolation checklist (network, hypervisor/GPU isolation controls)?
- Audit logs: need immutability guarantees and proof of chain-of-custody for exported logs.

Also, what is your standard on encrypted backups and whether we can store audit logs in our own S3 (we would ingest logs into our SIEM; preferred is push to our collector endpoint).

If Redwood can accept those redlines we can move to legal review and DocuSign. Please provide a mark-up or a DocuSign envelope with the redlines accepted/declined.

-Michael
Head of Security, MediSys

On Thu, Nov 6, 2025 at 08:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the questions — we’ll respond in the counter below and update the SOW.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Perez <procurement@medisys.com>, Michael Chang <security@medisys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; jordan@nimbuscloud.com
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity quote request — single-tenant + KMS/audit

Ana / Michael — following up with an updated commercial counter and answers to security items. Highlights below; full mark-up attached.

Commercial counter (final):
- 24-month reserved commit (preferred): list $75k/mo -> 25% commit discount = $56,250/mo -> compliance premium 15% = $64,687.50/mo effective before marketplace credit.
- Marketplace credit (NimbusCloud): -5% applied after premium = $61,453.12/mo
- Effective annual: ~$737k/year with included performance credit ladder.
- One-time onboarding & network setup fee: $20k (waivable with prepayment)

Security & compliance responses:
- BYOK/KMS: supported via customer HSM/KMS (AWS KMS & external HSM); we require KMS access policy and one-time key wrapping validation during onboarding.
- Audit logs: immutability via append-only storage, SHA256 hash chain, export via secure S3 push or direct streaming to your collector (JSON/CEF). We’ll provide sample exports and sizing estimates in the SOW.
- Pen test & subprocessors: annual pen test report shared under NDA; subprocessors list attached with 30-day notification clause.
- Data isolation: attached architecture diagram and isolation checklist (network namespaces, pinned GPU pools, tenant keying)

Commercial flex: we can reduce compliance premium by 5 percentage points (15% -> 10%) if MediSys provides SOC 2 Type II and a third-party penetration test report within 60 days of onboarding. That reduces the monthly effective to ~$56k/mo.

Next steps:
1) If the above is acceptable, request signature on the SOW/Order Form (DocuSign link below).
2) On signature: 4–6 week onboarding schedule.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

Karthik
